notes:
## Changes

- Phones and tablets get a Dashboard tab with most of the app's Dashboard: the headline figures, scenes added each month, collection size over time, drives, quality, length, video format, ratings, the largest folders and most played scenes, a year of plays, the top performers, studios and tags (by scenes, size, plays or rating), year by year, and performer details. Tap a column or a day to see its number.
- The Naming gaps section has been taken off the Dashboard.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
